scope: Exercise the existing DWG MESH level-0 edge/crease count guard with a generated AC1024 entity frame, including valid readback, malformed-count refusal, typed-state clearing, and same-object retry.

implementation.parserGuard: DRW_Mesh::parseDwg rejects a bounded decoded crease count greater than the already parsed level-0 edge count before reserving or reading crease values.
implementation.generatedFrame: The common AC1024 entity prefix is emitted through the existing encoder. The locally-authored SubDMesh body contains two vertices, no faces, one edge, and either one valid crease value or two values for the single edge. An empty R2007+ string-stream footer and the common handle stream complete the frame.
coverage: One-edge/one-crease frame parses and reads back the edge and exact 0.25 crease value.
One-edge/two-crease frame is rejected and invalidates the input buffer.
Refusal clears seeded and partially decoded entity state.
The corrected valid frame succeeds when parsed by the same entity instance after refusal.
implementation.fixturePolicy: Frames are generated in memory. No DWG/DXF fixture or dependency was added.

validation.diffCheck: PASS for the focused CMake, test, plan, and receipt changes.

limitations: The generated frame validates the local parser guard only; it is not physical producer evidence.
This does not qualify crease positional meaning, native crease effect, subdivision evaluation, MESH geometry, or 3D consumer support.
The broader P6 and P4-P9 exit gates remain open.
